arguments.Prompt: A 4x3 character sprite animation sheet arranged in a 4-column by 3-row grid with 12 distinct action poses on a solid uniform vivid magenta background (#FF00FF). Character identity matches Reference-1.png: a non-magical Roman legion heavy shield bearer wearing a worn legionary helmet, segmented iron lorica segmentata torso armor, pteruges, leather sandals, wielding a huge battered rectangular curved dark red scutum shield with a central metal boss, and a short gladius sword. Broad shield silhouette, strictly non-magical. Art style matches Reference-2.png: sculpted painterly dark fantasy digital painting, broken confident contours, sharp silver highlights on worn iron metal, pale layered cloth, material wear on physical edges, smooth opaque paint, no heavy cartoon outlines, no 3D render, no canvas texture. Perspective and camera: Elevated 55-degree orthographic angle viewing the character from the REAR-RIGHT three-quarter perspective (facing northeast / diagonally away from the viewer towards upper right). The character's back, back of the helmet, and rear armor plates are visible in all poses; torso and head are aimed upper-right away from the viewer. Layout and animation poses: Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows (12 poses total), perfectly aligned on wide empty magenta (#FF00FF) gutters. First 6 poses (Attack): 1. combat ready stance, 2. equipment drawing back, 3. attack windup, 4. equipment thrust forward, 5. withdrawal, 6. ready recovery. Last 6 poses (Defense): 7. ready, 8. feet brace, 9. hands and equipment lift forward to block, 10. torso leans into resistance, 11. slightly recoils while keeping guard, 12. steady forward guard hold. Every figure is fully enclosed within its cell's middle 60%, identical anatomical scale throughout, no touching cell boundaries, no text, no grid lines, no borders, no ground shadows, solid pure magenta background.
